part.deflection.title: Deflection
part.deflection.summary: A forcing move pulls the defender away from its post, and the piece it guarded is left loose; first, find the right defender.
ex.df.kylSr: Play as White and find the best move.
ex.df.kylSr.hint: The black rook on c7 is attacked by your rook on c3. Count its defenders.
ex.df.kylSr.solution: 53.Rd1+! The check hits the king on d6, the only defender of the rook on c7. After 53...Ke5 the king leaves the file, and 54.Rxc7 captures the rook.
ex.df.V9Ggd: Play as White and find the best move.
ex.df.V9Ggd.hint: Count the defenders of the bishop on f6, which your queen attacks.
ex.df.V9Ggd.solution: 32.h6+! The pawn gives check, and the king, the only defender of the bishop on f6, has to leave g7. After 32...Kxh6, 33.Qxf6 captures the bishop.
ex.df.1yuX7: Play as Black and find the best move.
ex.df.1yuX7.hint: Your bishop attacks the knight on e4. Count its defenders.
ex.df.1yuX7.solution: 35...Rd3+! The rook gives check, and the king on f3, the only defender of the knight on e4, has to move. After 36.Ke2, 36...Bxe4, and the bishop defends the rook the king attacks.
ex.df.AZu96: Play as White and find the best move.
ex.df.AZu96.hint: Count the defenders of the black queen on e4.
ex.df.AZu96.solution: 45.Rf8+! The rook gives check, and the rook on e8 has to capture it: the bishop on h6 watches f8. With the rook gone from the e-file, 45...Rxf8 46.Qxe4.
ex.df.yhrkM: Play as Black and find the best move.
ex.df.yhrkM.hint: Count the defenders of the white queen on c2.
ex.df.yhrkM.solution: 28...Ra1+! The rook gives check on the first rank. If 29.Rb1, the rook on b2 leaves the queen undefended, and 29...Qxc2. If 29.Ke2, 29...Re1 is mate. And if 29.Bd1, 29...Qxc2 also wins material.
ex.df.w24bQ: Play as Black and find the best move.
ex.df.w24bQ.hint: Count the defenders of the white rook on c1.
ex.df.w24bQ.solution: 26...e3+! The pawn gives check, and the king on d2, the only defender of the rook on c1, has to move: d1 and c2 are watched by the bishop on a4. After 27.Kxe3, 27...Rxc1.
ex.df.yVwet: Play as Black and find the best move.
ex.df.yVwet.hint: See who defends the queen on d3 and look for a check that also attacks the queen and forces that defender to capture.
ex.df.yVwet.solution: 32...Nf2+! The knight gives check and attacks the queen on d3: it is a fork. If 33.Rxf2, the rook on d2, the only defender of the queen, leaves its post, and 33...Qxd3 captures it.
ex.df.A0ceO: Play as White and find the best move.
ex.df.A0ceO.hint: See who defends the rook on f3 and look for a move that attacks that defender and the rook at once.
ex.df.A0ceO.solution: 30.Nd4+! The knight gives check and attacks the rook on f3: it is a fork. The king on e2, the only defender of the rook, has to move, and after 30...Kd2, 31.Rxf3 captures it.
